body.title: Begin again
paragraphs: Time. A day passes every 1 second. Days begin after 2 Wanaxes join.
An army crosses a plains hex in 1 day, olive woodland in 1.5, hills or cedar forest in 2, desert in 3. A full-crewed galley crosses 3 coastal or 5 open-sea hexes a day.
Your survivors gather into a new Host, with 1200 grain and 60 silver. Your standing with the gods is kept. You live on subsistence until founding; find a new home.
Food first. A city must feed itself. Starvation makes it shrink; below 50 people it falls.
The gods. You are safe from punishment for 60 days after founding. A temple takes 16 days to build. Build, staff and feed one in time; neglect afterward risks punishment.
Orders travel. A Runner must reach a unit in the field before it follows your new order.
Bronze needs others. Copper and tin lie on separate landmasses; trade, colonies or seizures can bring them together.
